_comment_duelPitchIntervalSeconds: Wait interval between pitches in duel mode [s]
_comment_duelPitchPreviewEnabled: Show predicted zone-pass marker in batting duel mode
_comment_batUseRightHand: Use right hand for bat control (false = left hand)
_comment_pitchTrajectoryVisible: Show pitched-ball trajectory in every mode, independently of batted balls
_comment_battedTrajectoryVisible: Show batted-ball trajectory in every mode, independently of pitches
_comment_duelTargetZoneMask: Target zone bit mask for duel mode (25-zone grid)
